summary: BCeID's wordmark as its official website serves it: a 220 × 58 reversed PNG (white lettering, gold e). It cannot be put together from held marks — none has a Garamond capital I or D, or an italic e — so the published image is kept.

assets.label: BCeID — Wordmark, reversed
assets.notes: “BCeID” in Garamond capitals with an italic e in gold between BC and ID, in white for a dark ground: the wordmark of the Province’s online identity service.
assets.fidelityNote: The website’s image, unchanged (220 × 58). Its white lettering needs a dark ground.
